headline: MIL @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.12 at MIN 4.26, with a projected total of 8.38. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIL moved -1.39 runs while MIN moved +0.94, changing the projected margin by -2.33 runs. The projected total fell -0.45, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +23.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Connor Prielipp has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Austin Martin, Brice Turang, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Royce Lewis because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
